title: Fleet slot recovery safety and native actions
description: ADR-042 Amendments 1 and 2 validation against disposable Git checkouts and both authenticated operator apps. Start workspace.rpc.live.ts in UI-proof mode, authenticate an owned proof device and CC tab, and set FARMSLOT_WORKSPACE_UI_PROOF_OUT plus FARMSLOT_WORKSPACE_PROOF_DEVICE. The fixture caller owns teardown. No product slot or model turn is needed.

proofTargets.claim: After a local-work decision, a real CC release and discard confirmation make the next unrestricted run select that slot without a picker decision.

Recovery verifies default HEAD and fixtures, binds discard to actual content, preserves retained evidence, and holds failed work until a guarded retry succeeds, and keeps completed teardown cold after cancellation.
Actual Companion presses release safe idle slots, exclude unpublished work from bulk, preserve cancelled discard, refuse changed-content confirmation and complete freshly confirmed discard.
The only free clean merged-branch slot recovers before normal write-task/prepare/dispatch without a decision; safe settlement resets it and preserves the settlement checkout receipt.

cc-selection.intent: Recover one stale slot through the authenticated CC fleet and inspect the next unrestricted run selection through the public gateway.

rpc-safety.cmd: FARMSLOT_WORKSPACE_UI_PROOF=0 FARMSLOT_WORKSPACE_PROOF_OUT="${FARMSLOT_WORKSPACE_UI_PROOF_OUT:?Set the UI fixture output}/rpc" TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=services/gateway/tsconfig.json node --experimental-test-module-mocks --import tsx --test services/gateway/src/methods/slot/workspace.rpc.live.ts services/gateway/src/methods/slot/workspace-probe.live.ts services/gateway/src/methods/slot/workspace-publication.live.ts
rpc-safety.intent: Exercise authenticated gateway refresh requests and assert independent real Git, fixture and persisted-ownership effects.

native-actions.intent: Press the native fleet controls and verify safe bulk, cancelled discard, changed-content refusal and confirmed recovery through Git and persisted status.

automatic-reuse.intent: Dispatch one owned merged-branch fixture, cancel it, exercise done cleanup on the same run, verify the force-complete replay fence and archive. Preserve all foreign tmux sessions and options; the caller removes the retained owned scratch.
